maria_support: Customer CustAlpha opened a ticket — after we pinned their model to a frozen variant the embeddings started coming back with a different length. They say nothing in their client changed.

alan_support: Can you paste the exact model id they pinned and one example request/response?

maria_support: model they pinned: `redwood/emb-legacy-v2@pinned-2026-03-05`. Customer payload (redacted api key):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/emb-legacy-v2@pinned-2026-03-05","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'
```
Response (trimmed):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,0.2,...],"length":1536},{"embedding":[...],"length":1536}],"model":"redwood/emb-legacy-v2@pinned-2026-03-05"}
```
Customer expected 768-length vectors (that's what their index schema is).

sam_ml: Thanks — quick Qs: did they migrate their index or re-ingest? any batching middleware?

maria_support: They said they didn't re-ingest. They use our hosted embeddings to push into a managed vector DB (third-party). It suddenly started rejecting inserts with schema mismatch. No change on their side.

vik_engineer: I just pulled the pinned variant metadata from gateway: internal config shows `default_embed_dim:1536` for the pinned hash. Upstream model release on 2026-03-01 increased dim from 768->1536. Looks like their pin pointed to a build based on the new weights.

sam_ml: Oof. Two possible root causes: (1) pin resolved to a model build that updated vector width (we should ensure pinned aliases include build-time manifest), or (2) our compatibility shim for the legacy embedding API didn't apply to pinned variants.

oncall_ml: Assigning INC-2026-473. @vik_engineer can you attach the variant manifest and push logs showing model fingerprint resolution?

vik_engineer: Attaching logs snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] resolve_model_alias: alias=redwood/emb-legacy-v2@pinned-2026-03-05 -> build=emb-legacy-v2:2026-03-01-f3a2
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] model_metadata: build=emb-legacy-v2:2026-03-01-f3a2 embed_dim=1536 quantized=false
```

alan_support: Customer wants a workaround ASAP — reindexing all their docs is not feasible short-term. Any short-term mitigation?

sam_ml: Workarounds: (A) serve the older build explicitly if we still have it: `redwood/emb-legacy-v2:2026-02-24` — ask support to change model param to that version; (B) we can add a gateway-level compatibility mode that pads/truncates embeddings to 768 on the fly and return a warning header — but that's risky and lossy; (C) recommend customer reindex to 1536 later.

maria_support: Customer prefers option A for now. Can we confirm the older build is still available and not GC'd?

vik_engineer: Confirmed. Old build `emb-legacy-v2:2026-02-24` is present in s3 and hosts. Quick test request locally returned length 768.

oncall_ml: Good. Action list: 1) Support to tell customer to temporarily call `model=redwood/emb-legacy-v2:2026-02-24` (we'll verify it's routable from hosted API); 2) Eng-ML to add a guard in model-pin resolution so pinned aliases record embed_dim in manifest and warn on pin creation if dims change; 3) Ops to check whether other customers pinned to this alias might be impacted.

alan_support: I'll message the customer with the temp workaround and ask for a window to run a compatibility check.

ops_bot: @channel incident INC-2026-473 created and assigned to eng-ml. Priority: P2.

vik_engineer: Follow-up note: found one edge-case — when a pin is created via console the backend copies alias metadata but does not freeze model manifest fields like embed_dim; so a later build substitution can change dims. I'll open a PR to include build-fingerprint locking for pinned aliases.

sam_ml: Also check batchpad/batching paths — if their client sends multiple documents in a single request and we had a bug that concatenated vectors for multi-input requests, that would show up as doubled length. But logs show single-vector lengths are 1536 even for single input. So it's the build dim change.

maria_support: Customer confirmed they can switch to the older explicit version for now. They've scheduled a maintenance next week to reindex.

alan_support: Closing loop with customer. I'll update ticket CUSTALPHA-553 and mark as mitigated. Eng please keep INC-2026-473 open until pin manifest locking PR is merged and deployed.

oncall_ml: Thanks all. For the postmortem: include root cause (pin manifest not locking embed_dim), impact (N customers with pins to same alias could see vector dim change), mitigation (supportable explicit version workaround + manifest-locking PR), and follow-up (add automated compatibility alert when pinned variant's embed_dim differs from previously-seen requests). :thumbsup:
